description: Machine-checkable contract for the ideate-quality surface. The ideate skill's output quality (diversity, trap detection, actionability) requires an LLM grader, so the behavioral evals live in eval/datasets/ideate-quality.json as manual/skipped fixtures. This regression fixture locks the structural contract: the skill body must mention the fresh-context critic option, the ideate-critic agent must exist with the right rubric, and the preflight gate must remain in place.

evals.task: Verify that commands/ideate.md mentions the fresh-context critic option and the ideate-critic agent, reducing the chance that a future edit silently removes the LLM-judge-circularity mitigation.
success_criteria: At least one of the checked files references fresh-context critic option
At least one of the checked files references ideate-critic
At least one of the checked files references agents/ideate-critic.md
At least one of the checked files references LLM-judge-circularity
evals.fixed_by: fine-tune: add ideate-critic agent + ideate-quality contract

evals.task: Verify that agents/ideate-critic.md exists and contains the load-bearing scoring contract: 3-axis rubric, scoring formula, trap field, cluster/deepen/provocation shape, and advisory-only caveat.
success_criteria: At least one of the checked files references fresh-context critic
At least one of the checked files references novelty*0.35 + viability*0.40 + fit*0.25
At least one of the checked files references trap
At least one of the checked files references clusters
At least one of the checked files references deepened
At least one of the checked files references provocation
At least one of the checked files references advisory only
evals.fixed_by: fine-tune: add ideate-critic agent + ideate-quality contract

evals.task: Verify that commands/ideate.md still contains the pre-flight gate (Step 1 explicit invocation + Step 2 self-judge) so the expensive divergent pass does not fire on closed prompts.
success_criteria: At least one of the checked files references Pre-flight gate
At least one of the checked files references Explicit invocation check
At least one of the checked files references Self-judge
At least one of the checked files references Open-ended?
At least one of the checked files references High-stakes?
At least one of the checked files references Open phrasing?
At least one of the checked files references ABORT
